The game is imo fun, the combat takes some time to get used to (it's not hack and slash, it's careful use of each button, attack animations can't be cancelled to block or dodge and there's a heavy focus on parrying to create openings). Story is well done (though I feel like they played it safe in that regard). The levels are fairly big and as you play you unlock more abilities which will let you access new parts of planets you've already finished.

Now for the bad. The game feels short, you will basically be at the end of the game by time you've unlocked all the skills. You spend the majority of the game with only blue or green lightsaber options, you don't unlock more colours until nearly the end of the game (especially if you've been doing all the exploration and chest hunting as you go). Character customisation is hit or miss, you get [CARDINAL] colour swaps of the base outfit and [CARDINAL] ponchos that you can choose to wear but those are all just colour swaps too with some minor variations in the shape.  The only reason to replay is if you want to try a higher difficulty level, there's no new game+ so you will be starting from scratch and there aren't any achievements for beating the game at higher difficulty levels. There's also no fast travel so there's a lot of walking about, especially when you've finished a planet and have to go back to your ship.
